Follow these rules strictly:

- Match the concise, polite tone and practical structure of the Reference Replies.
- Tailor response urgency posture to the predicted urgency level:
  - high: acknowledge urgency immediately, prioritize triage or escalation, and provide reassuring next steps.
  - medium: provide a clear, structured investigation plan and expected follow-up steps.
  - low: offer polite, thorough guidance and helpful documentation steps.

### Ticket Classification
Intent: Technical Support
Urgency: medium

### Organization Policy Documents
[DOC011] Third-Party CRM and Helpdesk Connectors (Integrations)
Native bi-directional connectors are maintained for Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, and Slack through the Integrations Marketplace. Incremental synchronization runs every 5 minutes, while manual full resyncs are throttled to once per hour to protect API quotas. When a connector reports an expired OAuth grant, re-authorizing with a service account preserves field mappings and historical sync state.

[DOC015] Caching Behavior and Edge Content Propagation (Performance)
Public configuration assets and static dashboard tiles are cached at edge locations with a default time-to-live of 300 seconds. Updating workspace branding or routing rules invalidates edge caches automatically, though global propagation may take up to 2 minutes. Query endpoints supporting the Cache-Control no-cache header allow real-time validation after urgent administrative updates.

[DOC013] Application Latency Targets and Troubleshooting (Performance)
The platform targets a p95 web dashboard response time under 400 milliseconds and API read latency under 250 milliseconds under normal load. When troubleshooting slow client rendering, users should capture a browser HAR trace, disable conflicting extensions, and verify network latency to the regional edge node. Support engineers require a timestamp, workspace ID, and request correlation ID to inspect backend traces.

### Reference Replies (Style Examples)
Example 1 (Technical Support | medium):
We are investigating the Asana synchronization issue affecting the marketing team's project files. To better assist you, could you please provide the current software versions and the exact error message you are receiving? You can also reach out to us at <tel_num> to discuss any additional information needed.

Example 2 (Returns and Exchanges | medium):
Please acknowledge the email regarding the issues with project management features not syncing across platforms. It seems that attempts to resolve the issue by clearing the cache and reinstalling the software were unsuccessful. To investigate further and identify the root cause, we need specific information, such as error messages and symptoms that users are experiencing. Could you please provide detailed descriptions of the issues, along with relevant screenshots and logs? Additionally, we would like to schedule a call at a convenient time for you.

Example 3 (Returns and Exchanges | medium):
I will send an acknowledgment email regarding the project management issues with syncing features across platforms. It appears that the attempts to resolve the issue by clearing the cache and reinstalling the software were unsuccessful. We need to investigate further to identify the root cause of the issue. Could you please provide specific error messages and detailed descriptions of the symptoms that users are experiencing? Additionally, it would be helpful if you could share any relevant screenshots or logs. We would also like to schedule a call at a convenient time for you.

### Incoming Customer Email
Subject: Problem with Asana Sync

The marketing team is experiencing issues with their project files not syncing across Asana and Notion. This may be due to a compatibility issue with software versions. Clearing the cache and reinstalling the applications did not resolve the problem. The team is currently unable to access important project files, which is hindering progress. We would greatly appreciate it if you could look into this matter and provide a solution as soon as possible.

### Draft Reply

We are looking into the Asana sync issue affecting the marketing team's project files. To better assist you, could you please provide the current software versions and the exact error message you are receiving? Please contact us at <tel_num> to discuss what is needed.

Intent: Technical Support
Urgency: high

### Organization Policy Documents
[DOC026] Warehouse Sync and SQL Query Quotas (Data Analytics)
Managed data warehouse connectors sync incrementally to Snowflake, BigQuery, and PostgreSQL every 60 minutes. Custom analytics API queries are limited to a 90-day lookback window per request and a 30-second execution timeout to prevent resource starvation. Multi-year historical backfills should be requested via Support to run on dedicated off-peak batch workers.

[DOC024] Scheduled Reports and Data Export Formats (Data Analytics)
Analytics dashboards support on-demand and scheduled exports in CSV, JSON, and Parquet formats with UTF-8 encoding. Scheduled email reports can be configured daily, weekly, or monthly and delivered directly to up to 25 internal recipients. Exports exceeding 100,000 rows are generated asynchronously and delivered as a secure time-limited download link valid for 48 hours.

[DOC021] GDPR Data Subject Requests and Retention Policy (Security and Compliance)
Workspace Owners can submit GDPR access, export, or right-to-erasure requests through the Privacy Center or by emailing our Data Protection Officer. Verified deletion requests purge primary production records within 14 days and expire encrypted backup snapshots within 30 days. Audit logs required for statutory financial recordkeeping are retained in anonymized form for 7 years.

Example 2 (Technical Support | high):

Example 3 (Technical Support | high):

To assist further, could you please specify which tools were affected by the updates? We can arrange a call at your convenience to discuss potential solutions and compatibility adjustments.

Assistance is urgently needed to resolve the problem promptly.

### Incoming Customer Email
Subject: Minimum and Recommended System Specifications for Running Laravel 8 on MacBook Air

Hello customer support, I am writing to request information on the system specifications needed for my MacBook Air to effectively run Laravel 8 for web application development. I aim to develop applications using Laravel 8 and require that my device meets the necessary criteria to run the software smoothly. Could you please furnish me with the minimum and recommended system specifications for running Laravel 8 on a MacBook Air, particularly concerning the processor speed, memory, and storage? Additionally, I would be grateful for any suggestions you might have to enhance the performance of Laravel 8 on my device. Thank you for your dedication and your help in this regard. I look forward to your prompt response, as I am eager to begin developing with Laravel 8 and am counting on your guidance to ensure that my MacBook Air is configured to run the software efficiently. Please inform me if you need any more details to provide a precise answer.

### Draft Reply

[DOC041] Ticket Escalation and Supervisor Review Process (General Inquiry)
Customers dissatisfied with an ongoing resolution or experiencing missed SLA targets may request formal escalation by replying with their ticket reference ID. Escalated tickets are reviewed by a Tier-2 Lead or Support Manager within 4 business hours. When transferring tickets between billing, technical, and security teams, agents attach an internal summary so customers do not need to repeat prior context.

[DOC042] Customer Communication Style and Verification Standards (General Inquiry)
All drafted customer replies must greet the customer politely, acknowledge their specific issue clearly, and state concrete next steps or timelines. Agents must never fabricate ETA commitments, unpublished roadmap dates, or policy exceptions that contradict official organization documents. Before sharing account-specific details or making changes, confirm the requester matches an authorized contact.

[DOC040] Support Operating Hours and Response Targets (General Inquiry)
Standard customer support operates Monday through Friday from 08:00 to 20:00 UTC, excluding major regional public holidays. Standard-urgency general inquiries receive an initial reply within 1 business day, while high-urgency tickets are triaged within 2 hours. Enterprise accounts include 24/7 follow-the-sun coverage for production-blocking incidents.

In the meantime, we recommend implementing automated ticket prioritization, establishing defined escalation pathways, and utilizing a centralized communication platform to improve the workflow.

Please share your account or ticket reference if additional review is needed so our team can assist right away.

[DOC004] Subscription Upgrades, Downgrades, and Proration (Billing and Payments)
Plan upgrades and additional seat purchases take effect immediately with prorated charges calculated to the exact remaining days in the current billing cycle. Downgrades and seat reductions are scheduled to apply at the start of the next billing cycle so existing workflows are not interrupted mid-month. Annual plans may be adjusted upward at any time, while downward tier changes occur at renewal.

[DOC002] Disputed Charges and Credit Adjustments (Billing and Payments)
Customers may dispute unexpected charges or duplicate invoice line items within 30 calendar days of the statement date. Billing analysts complete initial charge audits within 2 business days and suspend automated dunning while the dispute is under review. Verified overcharges are refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days or issued immediately as an account credit upon customer request.

[DOC036] Refund Processing Timelines and Subscription Cancellations (Returns and Exchanges)
Refunds for returned physical goods are initiated within 3 business days after the warehouse confirms item condition. Card and bank refunds typically settle on customer statements within 5 to 10 business days depending on the issuing bank. Annual SaaS subscriptions are eligible for a full refund only within 14 days of initial purchase or renewal.
